f.title: Prepare PSUR-PBRERs following INVIMA guide IVC-VIG-GU003
f.statement: To prepare the PSUR-PBRER for products with a Colombian registration that are marketed in Colombia, the holder should follow the INVIMA Pharmacovigilance Guide for the preparation of Periodic Safety Reports (PSUR), code IVC-VIG-GU003, version 02.
f.clause: IV.1 Elaboración del informe de seguridad PSUR-PBRER

rows.quote: Para la elaboración del PSUR-PBRER de los productos con Registro Sanitario que se comercialicen en Colombia, tenga en cuenta la GUIA DE FARMACOVIGILANCIA PARA LA ELABORACION DE INFORMES PERIÓDICOS DE SEGURIDAD – PSUR. Código: IVC-VIG-GU003 Versión: 02
rows.location: IV.1 Elaboración del informe de seguridad PSUR-PBRER
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: For the preparation of the PSUR-PBRER of products with a Marketing Authorisation that are marketed in Colombia, take into account the PHARMACOVIGILANCE GUIDE FOR THE PREPARATION OF PERIODIC SAFETY REPORTS – PSUR. Code: IVC-VIG-GU003 Version: 02

f.title: Prepare a single PSUR-PBRER for a product with several strengths
f.statement: For a product with several strengths, a single PSUR-PBRER is prepared.
f.clause: IV.1 Elaboración del informe de seguridad PSUR-PBRER (Nota)

rows.quote:
Nota: Para un producto que tenga varias concentraciones, se elaborará un solo PSUR-
PBRER.
rows.location: IV.1 Elaboración del informe de seguridad PSUR-PBRER (Nota)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Note: For a product that has several strengths, a single PSUR-PBRER shall be prepared.

f.title: Set the first PSUR under the 2024 resolution from the EURD list DLP and submission date
f.statement: For active substances on the EU reference dates (EURD) list, the first PSUR-PBRER prepared under the new rules takes its starting point from the EURD list data lock point and submission date; once the first PSUR-PBRER exists, the next ones follow the list frequency. Example: a substance with a 5-year frequency would have its first PSUR with data lock 15 June 2025, ready from 13 September 2025, and the second with data lock 15 June 2030, ready from 13 September 2030.
f.clause: IV.2 Principios activos que están en la lista EURD
f.applicability: Active substances on the EURD list

rows.quote: para el caso de los principios activos que se encuentran en esa lista, la fecha de partida del primer PSUR-PBRER elaborado con los nuevos lineamientos de la resolución se tomará como la fecha de elaboración del PSUR-PBRER. Una vez ya se tenga el primer PSUR-PBRER elaborado, el siguiente se realizará teniendo en cuenta la frecuencia de la lista.
rows.location: IV.2 Principios activos que están en la lista EURD
rows.review_note: Review: example dates are illustrative (one EURD row), not compliance dates. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: wording of the quote is circular in the source; meaning taken with the example, 86.
rows.quote_en: for active substances on that list, the starting date of the first PSUR-PBRER prepared under the new guidelines of the resolution shall be taken as the PSUR-PBRER preparation date. Once the first PSUR-PBRER has been prepared, the next one shall be prepared taking into account the frequency of the list.

f.title: Propose a PSUR frequency to INVIMA for substances not on the EURD list
f.statement: For active substances not on the EURD list, the marketing authorisation holder proposes a PSUR-PBRER preparation frequency to INVIMA; the approach may be made through a citizen-service appointment or by correspondence.
f.clause: IV.3 Principios activos que no están en la lista EURD
f.applicability: Active substances not on the EURD list

rows.quote: En un acercamiento con la agencia regulatoria Invima, el Titular de Registro Sanitario propondrá una frecuencia de elaboración del PSUR-PBRER. b. El acercamiento podrá realizarse mediante cita de atención al ciudadano o consulta por correspondencia.
rows.location: IV.3 Principios activos que no están en la lista EURD
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In an approach to the INVIMA regulatory agency, the Marketing Authorisation Holder shall propose a PSUR-PBRER preparation frequency. b. The approach may be made through a citizen-service appointment or a consultation by correspondence.

f.title: Keep the latest EURD-current PSUR available for INVIMA requests and inspections
f.statement: INVIMA requests the PSUR-PBRER by e-mail when needed during inspection, surveillance and control activities, and the latest current PSUR-PBRER (according to the EURD list) must be available if requested during a follow-up visit to the pharmacovigilance programme.
f.clause: IV.4 Presentación del informe periódico de seguridad PSUR-PBRER al Invima, literal a

rows.quote: El Invima solicitará el PSUR-PBRER vía correo electrónico, de requerirse durante las actividades de Inspección, Vigilancia y Control, y debe estar el último PSUR-PBRER vigente (de acuerdo con lista EURD), disponible en el caso de solicitarlo durante visita de seguimiento al Programa de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.location: IV.4 Presentación del informe periódico de seguridad PSUR-PBRER al Invima, literal a
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: INVIMA will request the PSUR-PBRER by e-mail if required during Inspection, Surveillance and Control activities, and the latest current PSUR-PBRER (according to the EURD list) must be available in case it is requested during a follow-up visit to the Pharmacovigilance Programme.

f.title: Submit requested PSURs through the INVIMA Virtual Office for traceability
f.statement: A requested PSUR is submitted through the INVIMA Oficina Virtual (correspondence) so that the submission is traceable by its filing number; only if the Oficina Virtual is unavailable (confirmed by a press note on the INVIMA website or social media) is it sent to the dedicated INVIMA PSUR e-mail address.

rows.quote: La notificación del informe se realizará por medio de la Oficina Virtual de Invima (Correspondencia para que mediante el radicado sea trazable la notificación.)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Notification of the report shall be made through the INVIMA Virtual Office (Correspondence, so that the notification is traceable through the filing number.)

f.title: Write the PSUR in any language, but the executive summary in Spanish when requested
f.statement: The PSUR content need not be in Spanish, since Resolution 2024015321 does not require it; the PSUR-PBRER executive summary must be submitted in Spanish when INVIMA requests the PSUR-PBRER.

rows.quote: No es obligatorio el contenido del informe periódico de seguridad en idioma español, teniendo en cuenta que la Resolución 2024015321 de 2024 no lo determina como tal. d. El resumen ejecutivo del PSUR-PBRER debe ser presentado en idioma español, cuando el PSUR-PBRER sea solicitado por Invima

rows.quote_en: The content of the periodic safety report is not required to be in Spanish, since Resolution 2024015321 of 2024 does not so determine. d. The executive summary of the PSUR-PBRER must be submitted in Spanish when the PSUR-PBRER is requested by INVIMA
